summary.text: GRAN EIENDOMSUTVIKLING AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2004-05-07. GRAN EIENDOMSUTVIKLING AS is registered to buy and own real estate, and to do what is connected to this, including owning ownership interests in other companies. Its statutory purpose is to invest in real estate and what is connected to this, including owning ownership interests in other companies. It was previously named RAGLAMYR NÆRINGSBYGG AS until 2007-09-03. Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 82 623 NOK and the annual result was -386 389 NOK; operating income was up from 80 400 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -407 351 NOK in 2024 to -386 389 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 9 316 511 NOK in 2024 to 9 403 378 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-05-02 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
